heading: Activities

items.title: Janasena 13th Foundation Day Celebrations
items.description: Led district-level celebrations of Janasena Party's 13th foundation day, calling on party workers to continue serving the public with commitment.

items.title: Flag-Hoisting Event, Kavali
items.description: Addressed party workers at a Janasena flag-hoisting event, highlighting the party's developmental commitments.

items.title: Media Briefing on Party Affairs
items.description: Addressed media on political developments concerning Janasena leadership and district affairs.

items.title: KISHORE AT Janasena CENTRAL OFFICE REVIEW MEETING
items.description: Kishore attended the review meeting at the Janasena central office with Naga Babu, reaffirming his commitment with the message "Na Sena Kosam Na Vantu."

items.title: GUNUKULA KISHORE SUPPORTS COVID-19 CARE WITH FOOD DISTRIBUTION
items.description: Gunukula Kishore facilitated the distribution of meals to 500 COVID-19 patients and attendants at Nellore Government Hospital on day one. Kishore emphasized Janasena’s commitment to community welfare and assisting those affected during the pandemic.

items.title: COVID-19 Relief Mission – Serving Humanity During the Pandemic
items.description: Led and participated in a month-long COVID-19 relief mission by distributing food and essential supplies to families affected by the pandemic. Worked alongside volunteers to ensure timely support reached vulnerable communities during the public health crisis.

items.title: Appointment as District General Secretary
items.description: Was appointed as the District General Secretary of the Jana Sena Party. Expressed gratitude to the party leadership and reaffirmed his commitment to strengthening the organization and serving the people with dedication.

items.title: Panchayat Election Campaign Leadership
items.location: Kota, Vallipedu, Kalivelapalem, Padugupadu, Kovur & Kandamuru
items.description: Actively led and coordinated Panchayat election campaign activities across multiple villages by organizing volunteers, engaging with local communities and promoting the Jana Sena Party's vision at the grassroots level.

items.title: Youth & Organizational Development
items.description: Participated in the District Executive Committee meeting and organizational review following the formation of the district committee. Focused on strengthening the party structure, empowering youth leaders and improving coordination among party cadres.

items.title: People's Voice Through Democratic Movements
items.description: Addressed public issues through press meetings and democratic movements by supporting unemployed youth, raising public concerns and advocating for transparent governance and people-centric policies.

items.title: Jana Sena Digital Campaign Leadership
items.description: Led the Jana Sena Party's digital campaign initiatives by coordinating online outreach, creating awareness through social media, promoting the party's vision and engaging citizens through innovative digital communication strategies.

items.title: My Contribution for My Sena Campaign
items.description: Actively participated in the 'My Contribution for My Sena' campaign, encouraging public participation and voluntary contributions to strengthen the Jana Sena Party while promoting transparency and collective responsibility among supporters.

items.title: Public Protest for Muttukooru Bridge
items.description: Organized and participated in a public protest demanding immediate action for the construction and improvement of the Muttukooru Bridge, highlighting the safety concerns and transportation challenges faced by local residents.

items.title: Standing with Ippatam Village
items.description: Extended support to the residents of Ippatam Village by standing in solidarity with the local community during public issues, advocating for their rights and reinforcing the Jana Sena Party's commitment to democratic values and people's welfare.

items.title: Rally Supporting Pawan Kalyan Garu's Vision
items.description: Participated in and organized public rallies supporting the vision and leadership of Shri Pawan Kalyan Garu Garu, mobilizing party workers and citizens to strengthen the Jana Sena Party's mission of transparent governance and public service.

items.title: Janaswaram Calendar & Public Outreach
items.description: Participated in the launch and promotion of the Janaswaram Calendar while engaging with citizens through extensive public outreach programs. The initiative strengthened connections with local communities and communicated the Jana Sena Party's vision for transparent governance and public service.

items.title: Varahi Yatra Public Mobilization
items.description: Played a key role in organizing and mobilizing public participation during the historic Varahi Yatra led by Shri Pawan Kalyan Garu Garu. Coordinated volunteers, managed grassroots campaign activities and encouraged large-scale citizen participation across the region.

items.title: #MyFirstVoteForJanasena Campaign
items.description: Actively promoted the #MyFirstVoteForJanasena campaign by engaging first-time voters, organizing awareness programs and encouraging youth participation in the democratic process while spreading the vision of the Jana Sena Party.

items.title: Farmers' Rights & Public Advocacy
items.description: Raised issues concerning farmers' welfare through public meetings, awareness campaigns and advocacy initiatives. Worked alongside local communities to highlight agricultural challenges and support policies aimed at improving farmers' livelihoods and rural development.

items.title: Humanitarian Service & Community Welfare
items.description: Led and participated in multiple humanitarian and community welfare initiatives by extending support to underprivileged families, assisting people during emergencies and organizing social service programs that reflected the Jana Sena Party's commitment to public welfare.

items.title: Janaswaram Calendar Launch
items.description: Participated in the launch of the Janaswaram Calendar, engaging with party leaders, supporters and the public to promote the Jana Sena Party's vision of transparent governance, public service and grassroots development.

items.title: Support for Contract Municipal Workers
items.description: Extended solidarity and support to contract municipal workers during their protest, advocating for fair employment conditions, improved welfare measures and timely resolution of their grievances through democratic dialogue.

items.title: Meeting with Dr. Ponguru Narayana
items.description: Along with Jana Sena Party leaders and members of Chiranjeevi Yuvatha, met Dr. Ponguru Narayana to discuss matters concerning public welfare, regional development and issues affecting local communities, emphasizing collaborative efforts for social progress.

items.title: Advocacy for Minority Education
items.description: Together with Jana Sena leader Jani Master, highlighted issues affecting minority education institutions and extended support to students and educational communities by advocating for equal educational opportunities and improved facilities.

items.title: Support for Anganwadi Worker's Family
items.description: Along with Jani Master, visited and extended support to the family of an Anganwadi worker, expressing solidarity during a difficult time and reaffirming the Jana Sena Party's commitment to humanitarian service and community welfare.

items.title: Championing Public Grievances Through JanaVani
items.description: Actively participated in the JanaVani public grievance initiative by listening to citizens' concerns, documenting their issues and coordinating with party leaders and local authorities to facilitate timely resolutions. The initiative reinforced the Jana Sena Party's commitment to responsive and people-centric governance.

items.title: Driving Better Living Standards for TIDCO Families
items.description: Visited TIDCO housing communities to understand the challenges faced by residents and advocated for improved living conditions, essential civic amenities and timely completion of development works to enhance the quality of life for beneficiary families.

items.title: Rapid Response to Civic Infrastructure Challenges
items.description: Responded promptly to public complaints regarding drainage blockages, sanitation and cleanliness issues. Conducted field inspections, interacted with local residents and coordinated with municipal authorities to ensure swift corrective measures and improve civic infrastructure.

items.title: Mobilising Massive Public Participation for Jana Sena Formation Day
items.description: Led large-scale public mobilization and coordinated party workers for the Jana Sena Party Formation Day celebrations. Encouraged widespread citizen participation through outreach programs, strengthening the party's grassroots presence and organizational unity.

items.title: Serving Communities Through Health & Social Welfare Initiatives
items.description: Organized and supported a community medical camp as part of the Jana Sena Party's social welfare initiatives. The program provided healthcare services, medical consultations and public health awareness while reinforcing the party's commitment to community well-being.

items.title: New Year Message to the People of Andhra Pradesh
items.description: Extended New Year greetings to the people of Andhra Pradesh, expressing gratitude for their continued trust and support while reaffirming his commitment to public service, transparent governance and the welfare of every citizen.

items.title: Inspection of 104 & 108 Ambulance Services
items.description: Conducted inspections of the 104 and 108 emergency ambulance services to assess operational efficiency, service quality and emergency healthcare readiness. Interacted with medical personnel and emphasized the importance of timely healthcare delivery for the public.

items.title: AI & Robotics Discussion with Youth
items.description: Participated in an interactive discussion with students and young innovators on Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, encouraging youth to embrace emerging technologies, innovation and skill development for a better future.

items.title: Inspection of Public Issues at Mettla Revu
items.description: Visited Mettla Revu to inspect public infrastructure issues and interact directly with local residents. Assessed civic concerns, reviewed ongoing challenges and urged the concerned authorities to take timely corrective action for the benefit of the community.

items.title: Pension Distribution Programme with Minister Dr. Ponguru Narayana
items.description: Participated in the pension distribution programme alongside Minister Dr. Ponguru Narayana, interacting with beneficiaries and reaffirming the commitment to ensuring timely welfare benefits and strengthening public service initiatives for senior citizens and eligible families.
